spans.s: kāhala, kāhalā (EI 24; IA 15), a musical instrument; a trumpet. See kākala.
kāhaṇa, kāhāṇa (IE 8-8; EI 29), Bengali-Od̤iyā; modified forms of kārṣāpaṇa.
kāhaṇa , Bengali, etc; also spelt kahāṇa and kāhāṇa; same as kāhāpaṇa = kārṣāpaṇa.
kāhāpaṇa , same as Sanskrit kārṣāpaṇa and modern kāhaṇ, etc.
